title: A newly verified commit deploys to an existing install without a GitHub CLI login
description: The deploy watch restarts an installed release with gh failing in its environment: preflight and apply skip GitHub CLI checks because the deploy key is already registered, and the newly verified commit reaches the control plane's /healthz. A first install without gh still refuses preflight naming the gh login fix and changes nothing.

steps.name: Redeploy an installed release without gh and verify /healthz serves the new commit
